report.explanation: Current telemetry does not support a bounded root cause. Payment traces show one OK span (61ms), gateway metrics are healthy (p95 73ms, error rate 0.14%, no timeouts or pool waiters), and the inventory deployment record only proves version facts. Order logs show 11 retained-heap-after-GC WARNs, but a short increase alone cannot establish a memory leak. No candidate is substantiated; hand off for targeted evidence.
missing_evidence: Traces/spans for gateway and order services covering the alert window to localize the degraded hop
Latency and error-rate time series for checkout/order endpoints to confirm the degradation
Memory-retention time series for order service to test the retained-heap WARN signal
Evidence tying any candidate cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration) to the alert
